text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we need to finalize the internal release note for the Wed 22:00 UTC change window. Draft is at https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/release/2026-03-22-draft — please add short snippets for your teams.

maria: I can do the rollback table + canary lanes. putting a stub in the doc now.

sam: posting the pin matrix here so ops knows what to pin during the blast. also confirm model version pin: model-x v2.3.1 (no auto-roll).

alex: thanks. confirm we pin to v2.3.1 and fallback to cpu-quant v2.2 if GPU nodes are unhealthy. add that to the 'fallbacks' section.

liz: tagging product copy review — @maria @sam can you keep microcopy under 2 lines per snippet? We want concise customer-facing bullets.

maria: yep — will keep it short. adding one-liners for: latency improvements, billing metric change, and minor API param rename.

ops-oncall: quick ops note — change window overlaps APAC late evening, please call out the embargo/locales line and the oncall handoff at 23:30 UTC in the briefing.

sam: noted. will add timezone table + handoff instructions.

deploybot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled run: canary -> ramp (22:00 UTC). Playbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-03-22. Canary duration: 20m. Auto-rollback on 5xx > 1% or latency P95 > 2s for 10m.

alex: perfect. maria can you add the exact alert thresholds from deploybot into the release note so the comms team can mention them in case of incidents?

maria: done — pasted thresholds and the alert channels (#incidents, #eng-oncall).

liz: draft internal announce blurb: "Deploy Wed 22:00 UTC — minor API rename, perf and cost improvements. Ops standby 22:00–00:00 UTC. See doc for rollback lanes." Short and clear?

ops-oncall: looks good. will be on standby and will escalate to infra at first sign of node flapping.

sam: final question — do we want an explicit freeze window for frontend touches? suggest freeze from 21:30–23:30 UTC.

alex: yes, add freeze. i'll add a line to the top of the doc and pin it in the channel when we're ready.

maria: one leftover — does legal need to sign off on the billing language? cc @liz for confirmation.

liz: legal review not required for wording, but send a short note to support so they can prep FAQs.

alex: timeline: finish edits by 18:00 UTC today, I'll do a final pass then pin in #eng-releases at 19:00 UTC. ack if you can meet that.

maria: ack.

sam: ack.

liz: ack.

ops-oncall: ack — will be ready for handoff notes.

alex: great — thanks everyone. I'll post the pinned internal blurb and the deploybot cue at 19:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
